snippet.title: Profiler Files New Orleans: Gameplay & Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
■ 10 overarching episodes, offering an adventure of over eight hours.
■ Multiple story paths and different endings for each episode, ensuring high replayability and a unique experience for every player.
■ Nearly 40 characters and over 150,000 words of dialogue.
■ Interrogations, profiling, clue hunting… and gameplay surprises!
Profiler Files is entering Early Access VERY SOON! Get ready and wishlist the game on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2729450/Profiler_Files__New_Orleans/
